translationRepairs: On dinghai Li Chenfu of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat was made military commissioner of Tongzhou.
On dinghai Li Chengfu of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat was made military commissioner of Tongzhou.
李承福 uses 承 (Cheng), not 陈/陳 (Chen). Li Chenfu is a romanization error; Li Chengfu matches the Chinese.
On dinghai, Li Chenfu, commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was made military commissioner of Tongzhou.
On dinghai, Li Chengfu, commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was made military commissioner of Tongzhou.
The literal line repeats Chenfu for 承福. Chengfu is the required reading of 承.

On guiyou He Ning, acting Grand Marshal and Right Vice Director, was chief envoy and Bian Guangfan, acting Minister of Works and Supervising Secretary, deputy, to posthumously invest the late Lady Zhang of Wei as empress; they carried the seal and register to the Shadow Hall at West Manor with full ceremonial escort.

On guiyou He Ning, acting Grand Marshal and Right Vice Director, was chief envoy and Bian Guangfan, acting Minister over the Masses (Situ) and Supervising Secretary, deputy, to posthumously invest the late Lady Zhang of Wei as empress; they carried the seal and register to the Shadow Hall at West Manor with full ceremonial escort.
使副攝司徒 is acting Situ (Minister over the Masses). Minister of Works is 司空 or 工部, not 司徒.
The Western Capital memorialized that the commoner Ma Zhirao killed his son Wu Jiu but he did not die, because the son had encroached on his mother's food.
The Western Capital memorialized that the commoner Ma Zhirao struck his son Wu Jiu to kill him, but the son did not die, because the son had encroached on his mother's food.
殺男吳九不死 records an attempted killing that failed, not a completed killing. The proposed literal removes the contradiction.
In the eleventh month, on dingchou, Deng commissioner Song Yanyun was transferred to Jin, and Jing commissioner He Jian to Deng.
In the eleventh month, on dingchou, Dengzhou commissioner Song Yanyun was transferred to Jinzhou, and Jingzhou commissioner He Jian to Dengzhou.
The Chinese names 鄧州、晉州、涇州. Bare Jin collides with the Jin dynasty, and Deng/Jing drop the prefecture type the source specifies.

On bingshen, the relevant offices submitted for deliberation that the late Commander-in-Chief of All Armies and Horses, King Qian Yuanguan of Wuyue, should receive the posthumous title Solemn and Solemn; an edict changed it to Cultured and Solemn.

On bingshen, the relevant offices submitted for deliberation that the late Commander-in-Chief of All Armies and Horses, King Qian Yuanguan of Wuyue, should receive the posthumous title Zhuangmu (Solemn and Reverent); an edict changed it to Wenmu (Cultured and Reverent).
謚曰莊穆 and 改為文穆 are two-character posthumous names. Rendering 穆 as Solemn in both titles invents a duplicated epithet and loses 穆 “reverent.”

On the first day yimao of the twelfth month, Left Leading Army Guard general Cai Xingyu was sent to garrison troops at Yun, and twenty-six inner-hall attendants were dispatched from Heyin to Haikou to patrol by district, because Qing commissioner Yang Guangyuan was plotting rebellion.

On the first day yisi of the twelfth month, Left Leading Army Guard general Cai Xingyu was sent to garrison troops at Yun, and twenty-six inner-hall attendants were dispatched from Heyin to Haikou to patrol by district, because Qing commissioner Yang Guangyuan was plotting rebellion.
十二月乙巳朔 is the first day yisi. Yimao is 乙卯, a different sexagenary day.

In the twelfth month, first day yimao, Left Leading Army Guard general Cai Xingyu was sent to escort troops to garrison at Yunzhou; twenty-six palace attendants of the inner hall were also dispatched from Heyin to Haikou to divide the territory and conduct inspections, because Qingzhou military commissioner Yang Guangyuan was plotting rebellion.

In the twelfth month, first day yisi, Left Leading Army Guard general Cai Xingyu was sent to escort troops to garrison at Yunzhou; twenty-six palace attendants of the inner hall were also dispatched from Heyin to Haikou to divide the territory and conduct inspections, because Qingzhou military commissioner Yang Guangyuan was plotting rebellion.
The literal field likewise reads 乙巳 as yimao. The date is yisi.
On jiayin Dan prefect Yang Chengzuo was transferred to Deng at his own request.
On jiayin Dan prefect Yang Chengzuo was transferred to Dengzhou at his own request.
為登州刺史 names Dengzhou, not the 鄧州 already shortened to Deng. Expanding to Dengzhou restores the prefecture without altering the rest.
On wuzi the emperor reached Chan.
On wuzi the emperor reached Chanzhou.
車駕至澶州 names the prefecture Chanzhou. Bare Chan omits 州 and is not an established short form here.
On yihai Cang, Heng, Bei, and Ye sent urgent word that Khitan vanguard Zhao Yanshou and Zhao Yanzhao were leading 50,000 horsemen in invasion toward Ganling—summoned by Yang Guangyuan of Qing.
On yihai Cang, Heng, Bei, and Ye sent urgent word that Khitan vanguard Zhao Yanshou and Zhao Yanzhao were leading 50,000 horsemen in invasion toward Ganling—summoned by Yang Guangyuan of Qingzhou.
青州楊光遠 identifies Yang Guangyuan by Qingzhou. Bare Qing can be read as a personal or polity name.
On the first day jiachen of the second month, Shi Yun was sent to hold Majiakou, He Jian Yangliu town, Bai Zairong Majia ford, and An Yanwei Heyang.
On the first day jiachen of the second month, Shi Yun was sent to hold Majiakou, He Jian to hold Yangliu town, Bai Zairong to hold Majia ford, and An Yanwei to hold Heyang.
The Chinese repeats 守 before each posting (守楊劉鎮, 守馬家渡, 守河陽). Dropping the verb fuses later commanders with the place-names.
Yun reported that Bo prefect Zhou Ru had surrendered his city to the Khitan and secretly agreed with Yang Guangyuan to bring the Khitan across the river at Majia ford.
Yunzhou reported that Bozhou prefect Zhou Ru had surrendered his city to the Khitan and secretly agreed with Yang Guangyuan to bring the Khitan across the river at Majia ford.
鄆州奏 and 博州刺史 name prefectures. Bare Yun and Bo read as personal names.
Xingzhou's men roared and charged with blazing eyes; casualties mounted until the emperor led the palace guard in person and broke the encirclement.
Xingzhou and the others roared and charged with blazing eyes; casualties mounted until the emperor led the palace guard in person and broke the encirclement.
行周等 is Xingzhou and his fellow commanders, not Xingzhou’s subordinates alone.
On Qicheng's old terrace they held a feast for the three generals, bitterly reproached Yanguang for failing to send aid, and wept together.
On Qicheng's old terrace they held a feast for the three generals, all reproached Yanguang for failing to send aid, and wept together.
鹹咎 is the usual 咸咎 “all blamed.” Bitterly treats 鹹 as a manner adverb and misses the collective subject.
On xinhai Xizhou commissioner Li Yiyin united forty thousand Tangut and Han troops, reached Linzhou, crossed the river, and struck into Khitan lands to tie down the enemy.
On xinhai Xia Prefecture commissioner Li Yiyin united forty thousand Tangut and Han troops, reached Linzhou, crossed the river, and struck into Khitan lands to tie down the enemy.
夏州節度使 is Xia Prefecture, not Xizhou (西州).

When Zhou Ru surrendered, the bandits held his soldiers to present at the command tent; en route the guards slept at night; one soldier freed himself from shackles, released the others, seized enemy spears and halberds, killed over two hundred escorts, fled south; at the river with no boats they floated across; of those who drowned, sixty-seven survived.

When Zhou Ru surrendered, the bandits held his soldiers to present at the command tent; en route the guards slept at night; one soldier freed himself from shackles, released the others, seized enemy spears and halberds, killed over two hundred escorts, fled south; at the river with no boats they floated across; after the drownings, sixty-seven remained.
溺死之餘，所存者六十七人 means sixty-seven remained after the drownings, not that the drowned were the survivors.

On jiwei Cang reported three thousand raiders escorting captives and loot toward Khitan lands by way of Changlu; light cavalry ambushed them, killing or capturing over a thousand, and the enemy fled leaving people and baggage behind.

On jiwei Cangzhou reported three thousand raiders escorting captives and loot toward Khitan lands by way of Changlu; light cavalry ambushed them, killing or capturing over a thousand, and the enemy fled leaving people and baggage behind.
滄州奏 is a prefectural report. Bare Cang looks like a personal name.
Ji reported defeating the enemy below the walls and seeing a coffin borne past; captives said, "At Qicheng the chief commander Golden-Head King took an arrow and died—this is his coffin."
Jizhou reported defeating the enemy below the walls and seeing a coffin borne past; captives said, "At Qicheng the chief commander Golden-Head King took an arrow and died—this is his coffin."
冀州奏 is a prefectural report, and the preceding sentence already names Jizhou. Bare Ji looks like a personal name.
